    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_906_edei--PreCommencementTenderOffer_c20261120__20261120_z9s10trke2vg"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2026-11-20" format="ixt:booleanfalse" id="Fact000027" name="dei:PreCommencementTenderOffer">&#9744;</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></td>
    <td style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Pre-commencement

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Indicate
by check mark whether the registrant is an emerging growth company as defined in Rule 405 of the Securities Act of 1933 (&#167;230.405
of this chapter) or Rule l2b-2 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (&#167;240.12b-2 of this chapter).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Emerging
growth company <span id="xdx_900_edei--EntityEmergingGrowthCompany_c20261120__20261120_zYECFVjVulj5"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2026-11-20" format="ixt:booleanfalse" id="Fact000029" name="dei:EntityEmergingGrowthCompany">&#9744;</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">If
an emerging growth company, indicate by check mark if the registrant has elected not to use the extended transition period for complying
with any new or revised financial accounting standards provided pursuant to Section 13(a) of the Exchange Act. &#9744;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: center"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Item
2.01 Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
November 20, 2026, The Marygold Companies, Inc., a Nevada corporation (&#8220;Company&#8221;), through its wholly owned subsidiary, Gourmet
Foods Limited, a New Zealand corporation (&#8220;Gourmet Foods&#8221;), and Gourmet Foods&#8217; wholly owned subsidiary, Printstock
Products Limited, a New Zealand corporation (&#8220;Printstock&#8221;), completed the closing of the Agreement entered into on September
22, 2026, with TAG Investments Limited, a New Zealand limited corporation located in Auckland, New Zealand (&#8220;TAG&#8221;), pursuant
to which Printstock agreed to sell substantially all assets comprising the Printstock business to TAG. Pursuant to the Agreement, TAG
paid Printstock a cash purchase price of NZ$2,456,567</span> <span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(approximately
US $1.3</span> <span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">million),
subject to potential post-closing adjustments,</span> <span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">in
exchange for all personal property, plant equipment, office fixtures, inventory and intangible assets of Printstock. </span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
foregoing description of the Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text
of the Agreement, filed as Exhibit 2.1 to the prior Current Report on Form 8-K filed on September 24,</span>
<span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">2026 and incorporated herein by reference.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Item
8.01 Other Events</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
November 23, 2026, the Company issued a press release announcing the closing of the Agreement. The press release is filed as Exhibit
99.1 hereto and incorporated herein</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">by
reference.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center">&nbsp;&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Exhibit
99.1</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: right"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>The
Marygold Companies&rsquo; Subsidiary, Gourmet Foods, </B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Completes
Sale of Printstock Products </B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><I>&nbsp;</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><I>-Corporate
Strategy Continues to Focus on Financial Services Sector-</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>San
Clemente, Calif., November 23, 2026 &ndash; </B>The Marygold Companies, Inc. (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;) (NYSE American: MGLD), a diversified
global holding firm with a focus on financial services, today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Gourmet Foods Limited, has
completed the previously announced sale of its subsidiary Printstock Products Limited to TAG Investments Limited, a New Zealand-based
private investment firm, in a cash transaction.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
transaction was structured as an asset sale, with a purchase price of NZ$2.45 million, (approximately US$1.3 million), subject to potential
post-closing adjustments. Gourmet Foods acquired Printstock Products during 2020 as a wholly owned subsidiary, and has operated it profitably
since then. New ownership intends to continue operations uninterrupted, with essentially the same staff and practices. Printstock, located
in Napier, New Zealand, is a printer of specialized food wrappers.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>About
The Marygold Companies, Inc.</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; background-color: white"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Marygold Companies, Inc. was founded in 1996 and repositioned as a global holding firm in 2015. The Company currently has operating subsidiaries
in financial services, food manufacturing, and beauty products, under the trade names USCF Investments, Marygold &amp; Co., Step-By-Step
Financial Planners, Marygold &amp; Co. Limited, Gourmet Foods, and Original Sprout, respectively. Offices and manufacturing operations
are in the U.S., New Zealand, and the U.K. For more information, visit <U>www.themarygoldcompanies.com</U>.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding: 0pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><B>Forward-Looking
Statements</B></FONT></P>
